lines.speaker: friar_lawrence
lines.text: Morning, Juliet. You sound awake. That's more than I can say for me.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Ha, I've had two coffees. Morning, Friar. Thanks for keeping the slot.

lines.speaker: friar_lawrence
lines.text: Of course. So, um, I want to hear about Montague. Benvolio mentioned something at a dinner last week, very vague, and I realized I only know the shape of it.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Yeah, so, we kicked it off yesterday. It's called Schema Bridge. The idea is that inspections from the Balcony App flow straight into Mesh Routing, their routing service, so a warehouse doesn't have to retype anything.

lines.speaker: friar_lawrence
lines.text: And who's the customer?

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Ducal Freight is the pilot. I've got a call with Paris Duke tomorrow, and Benvolio set up a demo for them on Friday.

lines.speaker: friar_lawrence
lines.text: Friday. That's quick.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: It is quick. But honestly the kickoff went well. Romeo, he's their staff engineer, he pushed us to send events instead of a nightly batch, and he's prototyping a local queue so Balcony keeps working if Mesh Routing goes down. Tybalt was worried about exactly that.

lines.speaker: friar_lawrence
lines.text: Good. Tybalt worrying is usually useful. Okay, so here's my one real piece of advice, and then I'll stop being an investor for a minute.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Go ahead.

lines.speaker: friar_lawrence
lines.text: The shared format. The record that goes back and forth. Who owns it?

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Um. That's the open question, actually. It's literally in my spec under open questions. Who owns field versioning.

lines.speaker: friar_lawrence
lines.text: Right. So get that written down before Ducal sees a demo. Doesn't have to be a contract, doesn't have to involve lawyers. A page. Who can change the format, who has to agree, what happens when you disagree.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Before Friday, you mean.

lines.speaker: friar_lawrence
lines.text: Before Friday. Because the moment a customer sees it working, it becomes real. Paris will start asking for changes, and if nobody knows whose format it is, you'll each assume it's yours. That's how nice partnerships get, uh, less nice.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: That's fair. I think Romeo would actually welcome it. He's pretty, like, low-ego about this stuff. Okay. I'll take it to him this week. I'm doing spec v2 by Wednesday anyway, so it can go in there.

lines.speaker: friar_lawrence
lines.text: Perfect. Now, the boring part. How's runway feeling? I don't need numbers today, I just want the vibe.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: The vibe is fine. We're on plan. Nothing's on fire. If Ducal turns into a paying pilot it gets better, obviously, but we're not counting on it.

lines.speaker: friar_lawrence
lines.text: Good. Don't count on it, and don't hire ahead of it. Good. Okay, last thing. I've noticed I mostly hear from you when something's either great or terrible.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Oh no. Is that true?

lines.speaker: friar_lawrence
lines.text: A little. Which is normal, everybody does it. But what I'd love is a short note, weekly. Five bullets. What shipped, what's stuck, one thing I could help with. It takes you ten minutes and it saves us both a meeting now and then.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Yeah, I can do that. Honestly it'd help me too, just to write the week down.

lines.speaker: friar_lawrence
lines.text: That's the secret. It's mostly for you.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Okay, I'll send the first one Friday. That'll be a good week for it, actually. Balcony 3.0 go or no-go is Friday morning, and the Ducal demo is Friday too.

lines.speaker: friar_lawrence
lines.text: Alright. Go write your page about who owns the format. I'll look for your note Friday.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Thanks, Friar. Talk soon.
